The '''fyrnock''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of four-legged nocturnal predator native to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the era of the [[Eternal Empire]], some were trained as mounts.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fyrnock is a creature created for the [[canon]] television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Rebels">{{Rebels|Out of Darkness}}</ref> It was later introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a mount available in the [[Cartel Market]] in [[December]] [[2016]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/807321599963709440|Star Wars: The Old Republic|quote=Can you tame one of the galaxy's most vicious predators? The Royal Fyrnock: Now live for Direct Sale on the Cartel Market!|archivedate=20200812143307}}</ref>
